items.title: Projects / 项目
items.excerpt: A curated set of research and engineering projects with concrete artifacts for quick scanning.
items.content: Selected Projects. A curated set of research and engineering projects with concrete artifacts, repos, notes, and write-ups. Formal Methods: Isabelle/HOL submodular greedy guarantees, monotone submodular maximization, cardinality constraint, classical (1 − 1/e) guarantee, reusable gap-recurrence framework, locale structure, theory files, research log, stochastic and lazy variants. Optimization Research: dual certificates that collapse under invariances, translation invariance, symmetry, trivial lower bounds, gauge-fixing, derivation note, meeting summary, benchmark comparison. Data: retention and cohort analysis from production tables, new vs returning users, D1 retention, post-k-th visit retention, inconsistent join keys, reproducible SQL, validation tables and plots, automated checks. Engineering & IP: anti-segregation aggregate spreading system, iterative parameter tuning, field feedback, IP filing, patent documentation, technical summary.
